description: Drainage Pipe is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. The data being collected is to be used for several purposes: - Hydraulic/hydrologic modeling input - Work Order Management System integration - Map book production - Mobile redlining/correction submission tools. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category City Infrastructure. Its tags are wpd, agoltosocrata, storm sewer, drainage, watershed. The table has 50 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
